en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a building's inner courtyard with arched columns and a balustraded walkway, likely from a historical European city. The writing on the right side and in the lower corner suggests it is intended as a keepsake image. The architecture is Renaissance in style, with thick stone arches and classic columns. There is handwritten text in a script that appears to be in German.
